claims.text: The patch led to an increase in the positive review share by 10.88 percentage points over the 14-day horizon. The game's discounts weren't tracked at the time, so a price change can't be ruled out.
Negative reviews mentioning performance issues rose by 1.12 percentage points in the window compared to the baseline.
Negative reviews regarding gameplay balance increased by 1.76 percentage points in the window.
Positive reviews mentioning performance decreased by 4.2 percentage points in the window.

findings.title: Patch impact on positive review share

report.summary: The patch led to an increase in the positive review share by 10.88 percentage points over the 14-day horizon. Negative reviews mentioning performance issues rose by 1.12 percentage points in the window compared to the baseline, negative reviews regarding gameplay balance increased by 1.76 percentage points in the window, and positive reviews mentioning performance decreased by 4.2 percentage points in the window. The patch is supported. A price change or sale is inconclusive. A review bomb and a change in who reviewed are ruled out, along with noise.
